environment.stockRuntime: installed DeepSeek Harness.app runtime CLI 0.2.1-rc.2 (no fork)
environment.install: DSH_HOME=... dsh plugin --profile web add file:/tmp/m1-lead-plugin

pluginInstallAndLoad.evidence: `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows `- id: whalegirl-m1 / name: whalegirl-m1`; web log prints `[whalegirl-m1] bridge listening`; hello-m1 probe plugin also loaded (HELLO-M1-PLUGIN-LOADED).

fixedDshSession.detail: Host plugin created fixed session `whalegirl-m1-main` via ctx.agents.create({sessionId, agentOptions:{provider:'deepseek-account',model:'deepseek-flash'}}) and attached it to a workspace (`session attached to workspace { workspace: 55e30bf1-... }`); sidebar shows workspace `dsh-bot` + the session; session file exists at sessions/--tmp-whalegirl-m1-home-whalegirl-m1-workspace--/whalegirl-m1-main/.

clientOverlay.detail: CDP evaluated `Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-whalegirl-m1]')) === true` in the stock DSH page; overlay is an independent fixed-position root (not DSH React tree).

textToDshPersisted.detail: POST /turn {text} -> 200 {ok:true, sessionId:'whalegirl-m1-main', messageId}; user message persisted in the DSH session jsonl.

dshReplyToUi.detail: The plugin-created agent's turn ends with prompt-assembly error `prompt variable "{{model}}" has no value for this assembly (section "deployment:persona-prefix")`. The official UI chat path works (UI shows model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and model list). Conclusion: plugin creation path needs the same model binding/prompt deployment context as the official session creation path; not yet mirrored.

presentationLayerBaseline.detail: Published dsh-pet 0.3.8 installed into the same isolated stock DSH (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet`) and its pet overlay renders in the DSH page (UI text `蓝毛小女仆`, plus our M1 overlay). Confirms presentation layer can be reused on stock DSH.

next: M1 follow-up: mirror the official session/agent creation path so {{model}} deployment variable resolves (inspect app.asar create path / client remote; or acquire model selection from the same service the UI uses and pass complete agentOptions).
Then M1 gate re-run: text request -> DSH fixed session -> assistant reply -> visible in DSH UI.

After M1 passes: fork dsh-pet presentation layer into m5/whalegirl-pet with cuts (independent chat/memory/balance/whisper/standalone/multi-pet removed), wire its bubble/input to the fixed DSH session via this host bridge.
